// blender_tag_ranges: Maps the CI Blender tag (encoded in each asset filename) to the Blender version range the package is valid for. This is how a single repository serves one zip to Blender 4.4-5.0 (Python 3.11) and a different zip to Blender 5.1+ (Python 3.13). 'max' is the EXCLUSIVE upper bound (Blender's blender_version_max semantics). Adjust here if Blender's version->Python mapping shifts.
// platform_map: Maps the platform token used in CI asset filenames to Blender's official platform IDs (manifest 'platforms' values).
// tools: One entry per extension. 'repo' is the GitHub repo whose Releases hold the platform zips. 'slug' is the URL segment used for pinned version-line channels (/<slug>/<major>.<minor>/index.json). The descriptive fields below are copied verbatim into every index.json entry for that tool (they are stable across versions; edit here if they ever change).

tools.name: 3D Survey Collection
tools.tagline: Tools for 3D survey: LOD, Cesium tiles, ortho & panorama
